name: WHO-5 Well-Being Index
description: The five-item WHO-5 measure of mental well-being over the past two weeks, using the official 2024 English wording and scoring metadata.
source: World Health Organization (2024), The World Health Organization-Five Well-Being Index (WHO-5), WHO-UCN-MSD-MHE-2024.01.
license: © World Health Organization 2024. Licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO. Attribution, non-commercial use, and share-alike terms apply to the instrument content.
intended_use: Brief assessment of subjective mental well-being in research or service evaluation. It is not a diagnostic instrument or a momentary EMA measure.
validation_status: Established instrument published by WHO. The shared two-week instruction is repeated in each item for mobile presentation; item statements, response order, attribution, and scoring are otherwise preserved.

measure.instrument: World Health Organization-Five Well-Being Index (WHO-5), 2024 English version
measure.scoring: Code All of the time=5, Most of the time=4, More than half of the time=3, Less than half of the time=2, Some of the time=1, At no time=0. Sum for a raw score of 0–25; multiply by four for 0–100. WHO notes that a raw score below 13 (percentage below 50) has been suggested as indicating poor well-being and the need for further assessment.
